QuestInfo.name: Student of the Resistance
QuestInfo.0: You are now an official member of the Resistance! To find out what that means, talk to #b#p2151000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151000# says he can't send you on a mission until you reach at least #bLv. 14#k first. You can hunt to earn EXP to level up, but there is also an educational program available to Resistance members. Speak with #b#p2151010#, the Instructor#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met with #p2151010# and asked about the educational program for the Resistance.

0.0: I know you joined the Resistance seeking danger and thrilling heroics, but I can't risk everything by putting a rookie in the field. Train up to #bLevel 14#k and prove you're serious about helping us, then I'll consider giving you a mission.

yes.0: You Level up by gaining experience. You can gain EXP the old-fashioned way by hunting monsters, but participating in the Resistance's #bEducational Program#k might be faster.
yes.1: #b#p2151010##k is in charge of the Resistance Educational Program. You can find  #p2151010# at #b#m310010010##k.
yes.2: Then I'll see you for our next training session. The Resistance is expecting big things from you.

no.0: I can't give you a mission until you reach level 14 anyway. Train first, kid. Then fight.

1.0: We meet again. Congratulations on becoming a member of the Resistance! I've had my eye on you. I believe #p2151000# sensed potential in you when they sent you here.

npc.0: You haven't gone to see #b#p2151010##k yet? He's right in front of the Training Room entrance to the right.
